<thought>From the 1H NMR data, distinct signals are observed at 2.71 ppm (3 H, singlet), 4.61 ppm (2 H, singlet), 7.02 ppm (1 H, ddd), 7.39 ppm (2 H, ddd, integrating to two equivalent protons), and 7.91 ppm (1 H, ddd). Each separate chemical shift corresponds to a unique hydrogen environment. Therefore, there are 5 different types of chemically equivalent hydrogen atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
